method.space: linear sRGB from 16-bit sRGB encoding, full definition
method.noise: Haar HH and mid band (G1 - G4) MAD sigma; chroma = hypot(Co, Cg)/sqrt 2; chroma_relative = the same on Co/Y and Cg/Y (hue and saturation noise)
method.detail: RMS of Y - G1 (fine) and G1 - G4 (mid) on the most structured tiles
method.chroma_edges: RMS gradient of the G1-smoothed chroma on the most structured tiles
method.factor: median per-tile ratio state / own neutral, tiles chosen on each engine's neutral
method.unmatched: Lightroom's luminance detail/contrast and colour detail/smoothness stay at their defaults; IPR has no sharpening detail control (Lightroom 25)
